{{Color box|{{party color|One Cebu}}|border=darkgray}} [[One Cebu|1CEBU]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} The '''Mandaue's at-large congressional district''', officially the '''lone district of Mandaue''', is the single representation of the [[Cities of the Philippines#Independent cities|highly urbanized city]] of [[Mandaue]] in the [[Congress of the Philippines]]. The city started to be represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the Congress by its [[#Lone District|lone congressional district]] after the 2022 elections.{{cite web|url=https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1115211/duterte-signs-law-creating-lone-legislative-district-of-mandaue-city|title=Duterte signs law creating lone legislative district of Mandaue City|first=Nestor|last=Corrales|website=newsinfo.inquirer.net|date=May 8, 2019 |access-date=October 21, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Emmarie Ouano-Dizon|Emmarie M. Ouano-Dizon]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas) and [[One Cebu]] (1CEBU).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=January 15, 2026}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history |- !Start!!End |- | colspan="9" style="text-align:center;" | ===Mandaue's at-large district for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]=== |- | colspan="9" style="text-align:center;" | District created April 5, 2019.{{cite web |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/downloads/2019/04apr/20190405-RA-11257-RRD.pdf |title=REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11257 : AN ACT SEPARATING THE CITY OF MANDAUE FROM THE SIXTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT OF THE PROVINCE OF CEBU TO CONSTITUTE THE LONE LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT OF THE CITY OF MANDAUE |publisher=Official Gazette |access-date=16 January 2026}} |- | style="text-align:center;" rowspan="2" | '''1''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|PDP–Laban}};" | | rowspan="2" | [[File:Rep.
